title: Bounded receive slice 3: bounded pack, delta and object-id decoder (SHA-1 PACKv2 under 2 GiB)
outcome: Bounded receive slice 3: bounded pack, delta and object-id decoder (SHA-1 PACKv2 under 2 GiB)
acceptance: Initial profile is SHA-1 PACKv2 with pack length below 2 GiB; a locally selected SHA-256 repository is refused before network and a mismatching remote advertisement before fetch; a typed object id carries its algorithm

Decoding uses the original pack plus two bounded append-only scratch spools and bounded in-memory tables; OFS deltas refer only to valid earlier entries, REF deltas resolve only in-pack bases, no implicit base fetch or unbounded cache

Inflate runs through caller-owned bounded slices; each result's declared size and copy/work counters are accounted before allocation; a reviewed collision-detecting SHA-1 library is used, with no home-grown crypto
Duplicate supplied object ids are rejected, all received entries are counted before refusal, and malformed/oversized entries yield bounded refusals
